data.one_liner: Forward and reverse geocoding using the Google Maps Geocoding API for Flutter and Dart
data.what_it_does: Provides async methods to convert addresses to coordinates and vice versa, returning structured GeoData objects. It handles errors with a custom exception and supports multiple results and optional language selection.
use_when: You need to geocode addresses or coordinates in a Flutter app
You have a Google Maps API key and want a simple, null‑safe wrapper
You need to support multiple results or nullable queries
avoid_when: You prefer an open‑source, no‑API‑key solution like OpenStreetMap
You need offline geocoding or a different backend
strengths: Structured exception handling with Google status codes
Supports multiple results and optional language
Zero runtime crashes and proper URL encoding
weaknesses: Requires a Google Maps API key and billing
Only supports Google Maps Geocoding API
data.setup_notes: Add geocoder2 to pubspec and provide a Google Maps API key in method calls

alternatives.name: geocoding
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Google Maps geocoding package with similar functionality
